    FAIR QUESTIONS

    Before you
    say hey.

    Is this just an AI-made website?

    AI helps us develop ideas and move faster. CAMYTA handles the creative direction, reviews the details and works with you on the result. Your business still drives the design.

    Can you work with my existing website?

    Tell us what you have. We can discuss social marketing on its own, or review whether your site needs a refresh or a rebuild. The recommendation depends on your current setup.

    What’s included in the monthly subscription?

    The website plan includes your agreed design and pages, hosting, ongoing care and a defined update allowance. Social work has its own agreed scope. Your proposal spells out the price, setup costs, term and cancellation rules.

    Do I need to know anything about technology?

    No. Bring your business knowledge and any photos or ideas you have. We’ll explain the choices in plain language and handle the website work.

    Can I keep my domain?

    Yes. We can work with a domain you already own. Domain registration, renewals and any transfer arrangements will be clarified with you before launch.

    Do you guarantee a certain number of leads?

    No. Results depend on your market, offer, budget and other factors. We focus on a useful website, consistent content and campaigns with clear goals.
